name: The Adventures Of Hooman
source:
A sci-fi comedy graphic novel where you play Hooman, an android too conceited to be scared and too lucky to die. Your crew is going to die but they could have avoided an untimely death if they had only listened to you. You are not the problem.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4457130/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一部科幻喜剧图画小说，你在其中扮演胡曼，一个自负到不会害怕、幸运到不会死的机器人。你的船员将会死去，但如果他们只听你的话，他们本可以避免过早死亡。你不是问题。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4457130/]Steam[/url]]
